text:
WEBSSO::enable
Description
This command causes APM to do the SSO processing on the HTTP request.
This is to allow admin to re-enable WEBSSO processing for a request if
it was disabled before by doing WEBSSO::disable for the request. The
scope of this iRule command is per HTTP request. Admin needs to
execute it for each HTTP request.
Syntax
WEBSSO
::
enable
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
ACCESS_ACL_ALLOWED
,
HTTP_REQUEST
,
HTTP_REQUEST_DATA
